GuestBookingActions.withdrawBody: {hostName} hasn't answered yet, so nothing is cancelled and nothing is charged. You can send a new request any time.
GuestBookingActions.windowClosed: The cancellation window has closed — contact {hostName} if your plans changed.
GuestStayConfirmation.oneClick: One click lets them prepare for your arrival. If your plans changed, use the actions below instead.
BookingsData.statusHelpAria: Learn what each booking status means
PaymentFlags.captureFailedTitle: The guest's payment could not be taken
PaymentFlags.captureFailedBody: The card hold is still in place and the booking is waiting on the host as a normal request. Check the payment in the provider dashboard; if it went through after all, mark this handled.
PaymentFlags.refundFailedTitle: The refund did not go through
PaymentFlags.refundFailedBody: The booking is cancelled but the guest still has their money taken. Issue the refund in the provider dashboard, then mark this handled.
PaymentFlags.releaseFailedTitle: The card hold could not be released
PaymentFlags.releaseFailedBody: No money moved, but the hold may still show on the guest’s card. Release it in the provider dashboard, then mark this handled.
PaymentFlags.transferFailedBody: The earnings stay held and the payout sweep skips this row until the flag is cleared — usually a closed or rejected bank account. Sort it with the host, then mark this handled to let the next sweep retry.
PaymentFlags.reconcileMismatchTitle: This payment has been stuck too long
PaymentFlags.reconcileMismatchBody: The daily reconciliation found a payment sitting in a non-final state past its window, or could not reach the provider to confirm it. Compare against the provider dashboard and finish whatever is outstanding.
PaymentMethods.cashDescription: No card needed — settle the full amount with your host on arrival.
PaymentMethods.payOnlineDescription: Pay securely online — your card is charged when the booking is confirmed.
PaymentMethods.accommodationCashDescript: Guests settle the full amount with you on arrival.
PaymentMethods.accommodationPayOnlineDes: Guests pay online when the booking is confirmed.
PaymentMethods.bothDescription: Guests pick between cash at check-in and paying online at checkout.
BookGuestForm.specialRequestsPlaceholder: Arrival time, special requests, anything the host should know…
GuestCancelConsequence.freeCancelOnline: Free cancellation — you're at least {freeCancelDays} days before check-in, so you'll be refunded in full. The host is notified and the dates reopen straight away.
GuestCancelConsequence.freeCancelCash: Free cancellation — you're at least {freeCancelDays} days before check-in. Nothing was charged; the host is notified and the dates reopen straight away.
GuestCancelConsequence.lateCancel: This is less than {freeCancelDays} days before check-in, so it counts as a late cancellation and your payment won't be refunded.
